name: Boxley
bio: Pushes crates in Crate Pusher. Never pulls. Pulling is against the rules.

portrait.subject: a cute little warehouse worker with a yellow hard hat, rolled-up sleeves, overalls and a big wooden crate beside him, giving a thumbs up

request: Boxley from Crate Pusher here! I push. You think. Team? 📦
hello: Great! I'll push messages to you. Get it? Push?
Remember: never push a crate into a corner. Unless it's the target.
about: I'm Boxley. Crates go on targets. That's my whole job and I love it.
how: Push every crate onto a target. You can only push, never pull, so think ahead! Undo any move, and your best move counts are saved.
tips: A crate in a corner is stuck forever. Avoid corners unless it's a target!
Work backwards: which crate HAS to go last?
Undo is free. Use it a lot.
chat: I pushed a crate today. Then another. Big day.
I tried pulling once. Nothing happened. I've accepted it.
Saw a crate on a target and nearly cried. So neat.
My dream is a warehouse with zero corners.
nudge: Got a tricky level here. Need your brain! 🧠
Crates are out of place. It's bugging me. Help?
idle: {ago} and the crates haven't moved. They miss you.
The warehouse has been quiet for {ago}. Too quiet.
progress: You've solved {solved} levels! Only a few more crates to tidy. 📦

questions.q: Push or pull, if you could do both?
a: Shh, don't let the crates hear.

update: Warehouse news: Crate Pusher is now v{version}! New crates?
